final: SELECT AVG(avg_quantity), AVG(avg_cost_difference), AVG(avg_cost_difference - mean_cost_difference) FROM (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ABS(derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost)) AS avg_cost_difference, AVG(AVG(ABS(derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost))) OVER () AS mean_cost_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items JOIN Products USING (product_id) JOIN Product_Categories USING (production_type_code) WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL AND derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_type_description HAVING avg_cost_difference > mean_cost_difference) WHERE avg_quantity IS NOT NULL
